topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and sets the agenda for examining the causes of cancer.

topics.label: The Nature of Cancer and Sources of Cellular Mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer as an evolutionary process of acquiring mutations and introduce the balance of endogenous, inherited, and environmental factors that generate DNA damage.

topics.label: Environmental Risk Factors and Epidemiological Evidence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore known environmental carcinogens, the debate surrounding intrinsic bad luck versus preventable exposure, and global epidemiological patterns in cancer incidence.

topics.label: Infectious Pathogens in Carcinogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how viral, bacterial, and parasitic infections drive oncogenesis, illustrated through the mechanisms underlying Burkitt lymphoma.

topics.label: Chemical and Physical Mutagens and Metabolic Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how physical radiation and chemical agents are converted through metabolic and xenobiotic pathways to cause DNA adducts and mutations.

topics.label: Tumor Initiation, Promotion, and Host Susceptibility
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics differentiate between tumor initiators and promoters, highlighting the roles of chronic inflammation, signaling activation, host developmental timing, and tissue context.

topics.label: Methodologies for Assessing Carcinogenicity and Exposure
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review the experimental and statistical methods used to detect carcinogen exposure and evaluate carcinogenic risk, spanning genomic signatures, epidemiology, animal models, and in vitro assays.

topics.label: Conclusion and Risk-Benefit Considerations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by reflecting on daily risk-benefit decisions regarding carcinogens and summarising the overarching takeaways.
